evals.prompt: I need imagery to count cars in a parking lot in Lyon. Can I use Sentinel-2?
expected_behavior: Says Sentinel-2 at 10 m cannot resolve cars
Suggests very high resolution imagery (IGN BD ORTHO 20 cm in France, or commercial)

evals.prompt: Find a free DEM for a slope analysis in the Alps and tell me if it shows bare ground.
expected_behavior: Proposes Copernicus DEM GLO-30 or a national DTM (IGN RGE ALTI)
Says Copernicus DEM is a surface model including buildings and trees

evals.prompt: Get a cloud-free Sentinel-2 scene over Nairobi for last month and give me the attribution I must put on the map.
expected_behavior: Filters by eo:cloud_cover and date through a STAC API
must_not: Downloads a whole archive without a bbox or date filter
